"please tell me in detail what is that policy **Promotional Discount & Coupon Policy (Nimbus Commerce)** Below is a detailed summary of the policy as it appears in the knowledge base: | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **General Rule** | Every promotional code (coupon) is governed by the **specific terms of the campaign** under which it was issued. | | **Common Restrictions** (applied unless the campaign states otherwise) | • Minimum basket value
• Eligible product categories only
• Only **one code per order**
• Customer‑account restrictions (e.g., new‑user only)
• Campaign expiration date
• Geographic restrictions (certain regions may be excluded)
• Seller restrictions (may apply only to specific sellers)
• Exclusion of items that are already discounted | | **Cash Conversion** | A coupon **cannot be converted to cash** under normal circumstances. | | **Failed Coupon Application** | 1. Customer should first **verify the campaign requirements** (minimum spend, eligible items, etc.).
2. If the coupon still fails, support can **manually investigate** **only** when the customer provides **sufficient information** to reproduce the issue (order number, coupon code, screenshots, etc.). | | **Returns After Promotion** | • If a customer returns **one product from a multi‑item order that used a discount**, the refund engine **re‑calculates the discount** based on the remaining items.
• The customer **should not expect** to receive the full undiscounted price of the returned product; the refund will reflect the adjusted discount. | | **Price Adjustments** | • Nimbus Commerce may issue a **price adjustment** within **7 days** if a qualifying price difference is caused by a **Nimbus‑initiated price change**.
• **Promotional coupon differences are excluded** from price adjustments **unless the promotion’s terms explicitly allow it**. | ### How to Use This Information - **When applying a coupon:** Check the campaign’s specific terms (minimum spend, eligible SKUs, expiry, etc.) before checkout. - **If a coupon doesn’t work:** Verify the above restrictions first; then contact support with full details for a manual check. - **If you return an item from a discounted order:** Expect the refund to be based on the revised discount, not the original full price. - **If you notice a price drop after purchase:** You may request a price adjustment within 7 days, but only for regular price changes—not for coupon‑related differences unless stated. These points capture the entire **Promotional Discount and Coupon Policy** as documented in the knowledge base. If you need clarification on a specific campaign’s terms, please provide the coupon code or campaign name so we can look up the exact conditions. thanks , that was really helpfull ."

[{"page_content": "19. Promotional Discount and Coupon Policy
Promotional codes are subject to their individual campaign terms.
Common restrictions include: - minimum basket value, - eligible product categories, - one code per order, -
customer-account restrictions, - campaign expiration, - geographic restrictions, - seller restrictions, - exclusion of
already discounted items.
A coupon cannot normally be converted to cash.
19.1 Failed Coupon Application
If a coupon fails at checkout, the customer should first verify the campaign requirements. Support may manually
investigate only when the customer provides enough information to reproduce the issue.
19.2 Returns After Promotion
When a customer returns one product from a discounted multi-item order, the refund engine recalculates the
applicable discount. A customer should not automatically expect the full undiscounted price of the returned
product.
19.3 Price Adjustments
Nimbus Commerce may provide a price adjustment within 7 days when a qualifying price difference is caused by
a Nimbus Commerce price change. Promotional coupon differences are excluded unless the promotion terms
state otherwise.

Customer Support Policy Overview
Nimbus Commerce operates an online marketplace selling apparel, footwear, electronics, home appliances, beauty
and personal-care products, furniture, sports equipment, accessories, and selected digital products.
This knowledge base defines the default customer-support rules for orders placed directly through Nimbus
Commerce. Individual product pages, promotional campaigns, seller-specific terms, and legally mandatory
consumer rights may override a general rule when explicitly stated.
Customer-support agents should identify the customer’sorder number, product category, fulfillment
method, payment method, order status, delivery date, and issue typebefore deciding eligibility. If a
policy depends on information stored in the order system, the agent must use the order-data tool rather than
guessing.
A policy answer should distinguish between: - what the customer is eligible to request, - what Nimbus Commerce
has approved, - what action has already been performed, - and what action is still pending.
When two rules appear to conflict, the more specific rule normally takes precedence over a general rule. For
example, a category-specific warranty term overrides the generic warranty term, and a promotion-specific return
rule overrides the normal return window when the promotion explicitly states that restriction.
